content: .{@-प्रिय@} {%a.%} beloved of women. . ({@-यः@}) .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (अशोक) Jonesia Aśoka, for women are fond of decking their persons with Aśoka flowers. .²2 Name of a medicinal fragrant plant प्रियङ्गु (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गव्हला</ns>). It is a small plant used in perfumed oils and ointments.
